conditionalApplicability.AUD-019: REQUIRED: engine accepts geometry.crop/rotationQuarterTurns/flipHorizontal in recipes and is advertised in README
conditionalApplicability.AUD-020: REQUIRED: engine accepts output.longEdge resize and is advertised
conditionalApplicability.AUD-021: REQUIRED: pe_render_preview + pe_export_jpeg both advertised in the C ABI
conditionalApplicability.AUD-031: REQUIRED: pe_cancel_* is part of the published C ABI

notApplicable.AUD-012: No valid synthetic DNG pair is in scope and the engine does not claim DNG-thumbnail-capability testing; real-camera fixtures are used instead (AUD-011/016). Capability remains unclaimed.
notApplicable.AUD-028: Engine writes no camera EXIF at all (only JFIF+ICC+minimal EXIF with Orientation/ColorSpace/Software); there is no GPS/serial stripping feature to conformance-test. Documented limitation, not a passed check.

notRun.AUD-034: Coverage-guided fuzzing requires a libFuzzer-capable toolchain; current MinGW host has none. Budget also not allocated.

oracle.referenceSha256Policy: pinned at run time from environment.json; must equal the copy shipped under tests/acceptance/oracle/
oracle.accelerator: numpy float64 vectorization of the same closed-form formulas, cross-checked against the reference comparator on a random sample of >=200000 pixels per compared case; accelerator/reference mismatch is a FAIL

lookFixtures.integrityRule: assetSha256 and manifestSha256 re-verified against index.json before use; tampering fails the run

wbScaleInvariance.note: 1/65535 screening hypothesis per test plan; failure triggers investigation, not threshold relaxation

geometry.comparison: exact-mapping-and-dimensions; pixel values through transferComposition tolerance

frozenConventions.cropPixelMapping: left=llround(left*W), top=llround(top*H), width=max(1,llround(w*W)), height=max(1,llround(h*H)), clamped inside the image; PROPOSED convention (docs specify normalized crop only), pending Tech Lead review
frozenConventions.rotation: rotationQuarterTurns is clockwise; engine mapping validated by hand-computed unit matrices
frozenConventions.orientationNormalize: dcraw flip bitmask: bit4 transpose, then bit2 vertical mirror, then bit1 horizontal mirror (matches LibRaw flip_image order)
frozenConventions.downscale: area-average box filter, FP64 accumulators; AUD-020 required case uses an exact 2x factor where every implementation-defined choice is irrelevant

runnerExitCodes.0: every effective-required case has status PASS
runnerExitCodes.2: no FAIL but at least one effective-required case is BLOCKED or NOT_RUN (or reports are missing/incomplete)

limits.note: checkpoint dumps (~1 GB per full-res render) are deleted per case after comparison; only metrics and small samples are retained

notes: Policy frozen before first engine run; effective-required list must not shrink afterwards.
Approval remains PROPOSED: executing tests does not approve the policy or the engine.

Engine contains two TEST-ONLY observability hooks used by this audit (B0..B4 checkpoint dumps via --audit-checkpoints, and PE_AUDIT_FAULT export fault injection). Both are inert without explicit opt-in; recorded in environment.json.
